history.text: Moved to ECW after John Morrison and The Miz won the title; a talent exchange allowed teams from either brand to challenge.
Returned to SmackDown after Curt Hawkins and Zack Ryder defeated Morrison and The Miz.
The Colóns beat Morrison and The Miz at WrestleMania 25, unifying the two titles, which stayed independently active.
The original title was decommissioned, leaving this title as WWE's sole tag team championship.
The brand split was reintroduced and The New Day were drafted to Raw, making the title Raw-exclusive.
SmackDown created its own tag team title as the counterpart after the brand split.
NXT became a third major brand, making its tag title the third major men's tag title in WWE.
NXT reverted to a developmental brand, reversing the recognition of its tag title as a major title.
The Usos beat RK-Bro in a Winners Take All match and were recognized as Undisputed champions, though both titles stayed active.
At WrestleMania XL Night 1, the titles were split after Judgment Day lost a six-pack tag ladder match.
